fields.title: H1B filing / case-detail record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of h1bdata.info's own HTML table columns / detail-page labels (itself a republish of the US DOL's public LCA disclosure data). Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, _warning on partial-degradation). "search" mode with fetchCaseDetails=false emits a lightweight per-filing row (employer, job title, salary, location, dates); fetchCaseDetails=true and "caseDetail" mode both emit the full ~76-field case record (wage, worksite, employer point-of-contact, sponsoring attorney).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: search mode: "em=<employer>|job=<jobTitle>|city=<city>|year=<year>" that produced this record. caseDetail mode: the exact case ID requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-search-summary (lightweight filing row), S2-detail (search row enriched with full case detail), S1-detail (caseDetail mode, direct case lookup), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this specific record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (no_results, case_not_found, http_5xx, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker -- currently only "case_detail_unavailable" (fetchCaseDetails=true but the enrichment fetch for this row's case failed; the search-summary fields are still returned).

EMPLOYER.title: Employer
EMPLOYER.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- sponsoring company name as it appears in the search-results row.

JOB_TITLE.title: Job title
JOB_TITLE.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- filed job title as it appears in the search-results row (often auto-generated/lightly mangled by the source dataset).

BASE_SALARY.title: Base salary
BASE_SALARY.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- annualized base salary as displayed in the search-results row.

SUBMIT_DATE.title: Submit date
SUBMIT_DATE.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- LCA submission date (MM/DD/YYYY) from the search-results row.

START_DATE.title: Start date
START_DATE.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- employment start date (MM/DD/YYYY) from the search-results row.

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- LCA case number, parsed from the Base Salary column's link. Not an h1bdata.info column header; kept as this actor's own derived join key. Use with mode='caseDetail' to fetch the full record directly.

caseUrl.title: Case detail URL
caseUrl.description: S1-search-summary / S2-detail -- direct h1bdata.info details.php URL for this case.

LCA_CASE_NUMBER.title: LCA case number
LCA_CASE_NUMBER.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- same value as caseId, as labeled on the detail page.

LCA_CASE_JOB_TITLE.title: LCA case job title
LCA_CASE_JOB_TITLE.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- raw job title field as filed (may include an internal SOC/wage code suffix).

SOC_CODE.title: SOC code
SOC_CODE.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- Standard Occupational Classification code.

TOTAL_WORKER_POSITIONS.title: Total worker positions
TOTAL_WORKER_POSITIONS.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- number of workers covered by this LCA.

EMPLOYER_POC_EMAIL.title: Employer contact email
EMPLOYER_POC_EMAIL.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- direct email of the HR/immigration point-of-contact who filed this LCA.

AGENT_ATTORNEY_FIRST_NAME.title: Sponsoring attorney first name
AGENT_ATTORNEY_FIRST_NAME.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- present when AGENT_REPRESENTING_EMPLOYER is True.

LAWFIRM_NAME_BUSINESS_NAME.title: Law firm / business name
LAWFIRM_NAME_BUSINESS_NAME.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- the immigration law firm handling this filing.

PREVAILING_WAGE.title: Prevailing wage
PREVAILING_WAGE.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- DOL-determined prevailing wage floor for this role/location.

PW_WAGE_LEVEL.title: Prevailing wage level
PW_WAGE_LEVEL.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- I through IV, DOL skill/experience tier.

H1B_DEPENDENT.title: H1B dependent employer
H1B_DEPENDENT.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- whether the employer is classified as "H-1B dependent" (high ratio of H-1B workers).

WILLFUL_VIOLATOR.title: Willful violator
WILLFUL_VIOLATOR.description: S1-detail / S2-detail only -- DOL willful-violator flag.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across search-summary and case-detail records.
